run_plot_benchmark: run the plot function to generate a horizontal bar chart PDF from FPS benchmark profile data files
create_benchmark_chart: create a horizontal bar chart with error bars from FPS profile data and save as PDF
parse_fps_profiles: parse FPS values from benchmark profile text files and compute mean and standard error statistics
review_plot_function: review the plot function that reads profile data files, computes statistics, and generates matplotlib bar charts
refactor_plot_for_cli: refactor the plot function to accept command line arguments for name map, savename, title, and base name
